projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No visible project. Ask an administrator to add you to a project.
projects.name: Name

roleRights.ADMINISTRATOR: Can do everything in the project, including managing its members and settings. No restriction.
roleRights.PRODUCT_OWNER: Can write, prioritise and approve requirements, plan releases and sprints, comment and produce reports. Cannot write tests, prepare campaigns, execute tests or launch automated runs.
roleRights.TESTER: Can write all tests, prepare campaigns, execute tests and exploratory sessions, log defects, propose acceptance criteria, comment and produce reports. Cannot change requirements or planning, nor launch automated runs.
roleRights.DEVELOPER: Can write automated tests, launch automated runs and comment on requirements. Cannot change requirements, manual tests, planning or campaigns, nor execute manual tests.
roleRights.VIEWER: Can view everything. Cannot create, change or comment on anything.

admin.title: Administration
admin.chooseProject: Select a project to manage its members.

csv.title: Import requirements (CSV)
csv.help: Columns: type; parent key; title; asA; iWant; soThat; priority; points; tags; acceptance criteria (separated by “||”). Separator “;” or “,”. All or nothing: on error, nothing is imported.

hint.NOT_COVERED: No linked test (verifies or partially verifies).
hint.IN_PROGRESS: At least one execution, other tests not run yet.
hint.VALIDATED: The last execution of every linked test passed.
hint.FAILED: A linked test failed or a blocking defect is open.
hint.BLOCKED: A linked test is blocked, none failed.
hint.SUSPECT: The requirement changed since a linked test was reviewed.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.allTestsHint: To link a test not yet linked in one click
traceability.cellLegend: V: verifies · PV: partially verifies · R: informative · ⚠: suspect · click an empty cell: link
traceability.noTests: No linked test in this scope. Turn on “Show all tests” to create links.
traceability.suspectHint: The requirement changed since this test was last reviewed: check it is still up to date.

formula.design: Leaf requirements linked to at least one test (verifies or partially verifies) ÷ leaf requirements in scope.
formula.criteria: Acceptance criteria linked to at least one test ÷ criteria in scope.
formula.execution: Requirements whose linked tests have all been run ÷ covered requirements.
formula.validation: Requirements whose linked tests all passed on their last run ÷ covered requirements.
formula.riskWeighted: Design coverage where each requirement weighs 1, 2, 4 or 8 by risk.

impact.title: Impact analysis

impact.summary_other: {{count}} tests to review if this requirement changes ({{suspect}} already flagged suspect).

strategyHint.TAG: Tests with this tag or execution tag (smoke, regression…).
strategyHint.IMPACT: Tests to review for the chosen requirements; none chosen: tests with a suspect link.
strategyHint.FROM_CAMPAIGN: Tests of a chosen campaign by their latest result (default: failed or in error).
